verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-raa tilka aayaatul-kitaabil-hakeem
Akaana lin-naasi ajaban an awhaynaa ilaa rajulin minhum an andhirin-naasa wa bashshiril-ladheena aamanoo anna lahum qadama sidqin inda rabbihim qaalal-kaafiroona inna haadhaa lasaahirun mubeen

Inna rabbakumu Allaahul-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda fee sittati ayyaamin thumma istawaa alal-arshi yudabbirul-amra maa min shafee'in illaa min ba'di idhnihi dhalikumu Allaahu rabbukum fa'budoohu afalaa tadhakkaroon

Ilayhi marji'ukum jamee'an wa'da Allaahi haqqan innahu yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhu liyajziyal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati bil-qisti wal-ladheena kafaroo lahum sharaabun min hameemin wa adhaabun aleemun bimaa kaanoo yakfuroon
Huwal-ladhee ja'alash-shamsa diyaa'an wal-qamara nooran wa qaddarahu manaazila lita'lamoo adadas-sineena wal-hisaaba maa khalaqa Allaahu dhaalika illaa bil-haqqi yufassilul-aayaati liqawmin ya'lamoon
Inna fikh-tilaafil-layli wan-nahaari wa maa khalaqa Allaahu fis-samaawaati wal-ardi la-aayaatin liqawmin yattaqoon
Innal-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa wa radoo bil-hayaatid-dunyaa watma'annoo bihaa wal-ladheena hum an aayaatinaa ghaafiloon
Ulaa'ika ma'waahumun-naaru bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati yahdeehim rabbuhum bi-eemaanihim tajree min tahtihimul-anhaaru fee jannaatin-na'eem
Da'waahum feehaa subhaanaka Allaahumma wa tahiyyatuhum feehaa salaamun wa aakhiru da'waahum anil-hamdu Lillaahi rabbil-aalameen
Wa law yu'ajjilu Allaahu lin-naasish-sharra isti'jaalahum bil-khayri laqudiya ilayhim ajaluhum fanadharul-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

Wa idhaa massal-insaanad-durru da'aanaa lijanbihi aw qaa'idan aw qaa'iman falammaa kashafnaa anhu durrahu marra ka'an lam yad'unaa ilaa durrin massahu kadhaalika zuyyina lilmusrifeena maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Wa laqad ahlaknal-quroona min qablikum lammaa zalamoo wa jaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati wa maa kaanoo liyu'minoo kadhaalika najzil-qawmal-mujrimeen
Thumma ja'alnaakum khalaa'ifa fil-ardi min ba'dihim linanzura kayfa ta'maloon

Wa idhaa tutlaa alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaalal-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa i'ti biqur'aanin ghayri haadhaa aw baddilhu qul maa yakoonu lee an ubaddilahu min tilqaa'i nafsee in attabi'u illaa maa yoohaa ilayya innee akhaafu in asaytu rabbee adhaaba yawmin azeem
Qul law shaa'a Allaahu maa talawtuhu alaykum wa laa adraakum bihi faqad labithtu feekum umuran min qablihi afalaa ta'qiloon
Faman azlamu mimmani iftaraa alaa Allaahi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bi-aayaatihi innahu laa yuflihul-mujrimoon

Wa ya'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yadurruhum wa laa yanfa'uhum wa yaqooloona haa'ulaa'i shufa'aa'uunaa indallaahi qul atunabbi'oona Allaaha bimaa laa ya'lamu fis-samaawaati wa laa fil-ardi subhaanahu wa ta'aalaa ammaa yushrikoon
Wa maa kaanan-naasu illaa ummatan waahidatan fakhtalafoo wa lawlaa kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum feemaa feehi yakhtalifoon
Wa yaqooloona lawlaa unzila alayhi aayatun min rabbihi faqul innamal-ghaybu Lillaahi fantaziroo innee ma'akum minal-muntazireen
Wa idhaa adhaqnan-naasa rahmatan min ba'di darraa'a massathum idhaa lahum makrun fee aayaatinaa quli Allaahu asra'u makran inna rusulanaa yaktuboona maa tamkuroon

Huwal-ladhee yusayyirukum fil-barri wal-bahri hattaa idhaa kuntum fil-fulki wa jarayna bihim bireehin tayyibatin wa farihoo bihaa jaa'athaa reehun aasifun wa jaa'ahumul-mawju min kulli makaanin wa zannoo annahum uheeta bihim da'aw Allaaha mukhliseena lahud-deena la-in anjaytanaa min haadhihi lanakoonanna minash-shaakireen

Falammaa anjaahum idhaa hum yabghoona fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi yaa ayyuhan-naasu innamaa baghyukum alaa anfusikum mataa'al-hayaatid-dunyaa thumma ilaynaa marji'ukum fanunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

Innamaa mathalul-hayaatid-dunyaa kamaa'in anzalnaahu minas-samaa'i fakhtalata bihi nabaatul-ardi mimmaa ya'kulun-naasu wal-an'aam hattaa idhaa akhadhatil-ardu zukhrufahaa wazzayyanat wa zanna ahluhaa annahum qaadiroona alayhaa ataahaa amrunaa laylan aw nahaaran faja'alnaahaa haseedan ka'an lam taghna bil-amsi kadhaalika nufassilul-aayaati liqawmin yatafakkaroon
Wallaahu yad'oo ilaa daaris-salaami wa yahdee man yashaa'u ilaa siraatin mustaqeem
Lilladheena ahsanul-husnaa wa ziyaadatun wa laa yarhaqu wujoohahum qatarun wa laa dhillatun ulaa'ika ashaabul-jannati hum feehaa khaalidoon

Wal-ladheena kasabus-sayyi'aati jazaa'u sayyi'atin bimithlihaa wa tarhaquhum dhillatun maa lahum mina Allaahi min aasimin ka'annamaa ughshiyat wujoohuhum qita'an minal-layli muzliman ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaalidoon
Wa yawma nahshuruhum jamee'an thumma naqoolu lilladheena ashrakoo makaanakum antum wa shurakaa'uukum fazayyalnaa baynahum wa qaala shurakaa'uuhum maa kuntum iyyaanaa ta'budoon
Fakafaa Billaahi shaheedan baynanaa wa baynakum in kunnaa an ibaadatikum laghaafileen
Hunaalika tabloo kullu nafsin maa aslafat wa ruddoo ilaa Allaahi mawlaahumul-haqqi wa dalla anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon

Qul man yarzuqukum minas-samaa'i wal-ardi amman yamlikus-sam'a wal-absaara wa man yukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wa yukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayyi wa man yudabbirul-amra fasayaqooloona Allaahu faqul afalaa tattaqoon
Fadhalikumu Allaahu rabbukumul-haqqu famaadhaa ba'dal-haqqi illad-dalaalu fa-annaa tusrafoon
Kadhaalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika alal-ladheena fasaqoo annahum laa yu'minoon
Qul hal min shurakaa'ikum man yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhu quli Allaahu yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhu fa-annaa tu'ufakoon
Qul hal min shurakaa'ikum man yahdee ilal-haqqi quli Allaahu yahdee lilhaqqi afaman yahdee ilal-haqqi ahaqqu an yuttaba'a amman laa yahiddee illaa an yuhdaa famaa lakum kayfa tahkumoon
Wa maa yattabi'u aktharuhum illaa zannan innaz-zanna laa yughnee minal-haqqi shay'an innallaaha aleemun bimaa yaf'aloon
Wa maa kaana haadhal-qur'aanu an yuftaraa min doonillaahi wa laakin tasdeeqal-ladhee bayna yadayhi wa tafseelal-kitaabi laa rayba feehi min rabbil-aalameen
Am yaqooloona iftaraahu qul fa'too bisooratin mithlihi wad'oo manis-tata'tum min doonillaahi in kuntum saadiqeen
Bal kadhdhaboo bimaa lam yuheetoo bi-ilmihi wa lammaa ya'tihim ta'weeluhu kadhaalika kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim fanzur kayfa kaana aaqibatuz-zaalimeen
Wa minhum man yu'minu bihi wa minhum man laa yu'minu bihi wa rabbuka a'lamu bil-mufsideen
Wa in kadhdhabooka faqul lee amalee wa lakum amalukum antum baree'oona mimmaa a'malu wa anaa baree'un mimmaa ta'maloon
Wa minhum man yastami'oona ilayka afa'anta tusmi'us-summa wa law kaanoo laa ya'qiloon
Wa minhum man yanzuru ilayka afa'anta tahdil-umya wa law kaanoo laa yubsiroon
Innallaaha laa yazlimun-naasa shay'an wa laakinnan-naasa anfusahum yazlimoon
Wa yawma yahshuruhum ka'an lam yalbathoo illaa saa'atan minan-nahaari yata'aarafoona baynahum qad khasiral-ladheena kadhdhaboo biliqaa'i Allaahi wa maa kaanoo muhtadeen
Wa immaa nuriyannaka ba'dal-ladhee na'iduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilaynaa marji'uhum thumma Allaahu shaheedun alaa maa yaf'aloon
Wa likulli ummatin rasoolun fa-idhaa jaa'a rasooluhum qudiya baynahum bil-qisti wa hum laa yuzlamoon
Wa yaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul laa amliku linafsee darran wa laa naf'an illaa maa shaa'a Allaahu likulli ummatin ajalun idhaa jaa'a ajaluhum falaa yasta'khiroona saa'atan wa laa yastaqdimoon
Qul ara'aytum in ataakum adhaabuhu bayaatan aw nahaaran maadhaa yasta'jilu minhul-mujrimoon
Athumma idhaa maa waqa'a aamantum bihi aal'aana wa qad kuntum bihi tasta'jiloon
Thumma qeela lilladheena zalamoo dhooqoo adhaabal-khuldi hal tujzawna illaa bimaa kuntum taksiboon
Wa yastanbi'oonaka ahaqqun huwa qul ee wa rabbee innahu lahaqqun wa maa antum bimu'jizeen
Wa law anna likulli nafsin zalamat maa fil-ardi laaftadat bihi wa asarrun-nadaamata lammaa ra'aw al-adhaaba wa qudiya baynahum bil-qisti wa hum laa yuzlamoon
Alaa inna Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi alaa inna wa'da Allaahi haqqun wa laakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Huwa yuhyee wa yumeetu wa ilayhi turja'oon
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu qad jaa'atkum maw'izatun min rabbikum wa shifaa'un limaa fis-sudoori wa hudan wa rahmatun lilmu'mineen
Qul bifadli Allaahi wa birahmatihi fabidhaalika falyafrahoo huwa khayrun mimmaa yajma'oon
Qul ara'aytum maa anzala Allaahu lakum min rizqin faja'altum minhu haraaman wa halaalan qul aalllahu adhina lakum am alaa Allaahi taftaroon
Wa maa zannul-ladheena yaftaroona alaa Allaahil-kadhiba yawmal-qiyaamati innallaaha ladhoo fadlin alan-naasi wa laakinna aktharahum laa yashkuroon

Wa maa takoonu fee sha'nin wa maa tatloo minhu min qur'aanin wa laa ta'maloona min amalin illaa kunnaa alaykum shuhoodan idh tufeedoona feehi wa maa ya'zubu an rabbika min mithqaali dharratin fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa laa asghara min dhaalika wa laa akbara illaa fee kitaabin mubeen
Alaa inna awliyaa'a Allaahi laa khawfun alayhim wa laa hum yahzanoon
Al-ladheena aamanoo wa kaanoo yattaqoon
Lahumul-bushraa fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa fil-aakhirati laa tabdeela likalimaati Allaahi dhaalika huwal-fawzul-azeem
Wa laa yahzunka qawluhum innal-izzata Lillaahi jamee'an huwas-samee'ul-aleem
Alaa inna Lillaahi man fis-samaawaati wa man fil-ardi wa maa yattabi'ul-ladheena yad'oona min doonillaahi shurakaa'a in yattabi'oona illaz-zanna wa in hum illaa yakhrusoon
Huwal-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-layla litaskunoo feehi wan-nahaara mubsiran inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin yasma'oon
Qaalut-takhadha Allaahu waladan subhaanahu huwal-ghaniyyu lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi in indakum min sultaanin bihadhaa ataqooloona alaa Allaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Qul innal-ladheena yaftaroona alaa Allaahil-kadhiba laa yuflihoon
Mataa'un fid-dunyaa thumma ilaynaa marji'uhum thumma nudheequhumul-adhaabash-shadeeda bimaa kaanoo yakfuroon

Watlu alayhim naba'a noohin idh qaala liqawmihi yaa qawmi in kaana kabura alaykum maqaamee wa tadhkeeree bi-aayaa ti Allaahi fa-alaa Allaahi tawakkaltu fa-ajmi'oo amrakum wa shurakaa'akum thumma laa yakun amrukum alaykum ghummatan thumma uqdoo ilayya wa laa tunziroon
Fa-in tawallaytum famaa sa'altukum min ajrin in ajree illaa alaa Allaahi wa umirtu an akoona minal-muslimeen
Fakadhdhaboohu fanajjaynaahu wa man ma'ahu fil-fulki wa ja'alnaahum khalaa'ifa wa aghraqnal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa fanzur kayfa kaana aaqibatul-mundhareen
Thumma ba'athnaa min ba'dihi rusulan ilaa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bil-bayyinaati famaa kaanoo liyu'minoo bimaa kadhdhaboo bihi min qablu kadhaalika natba'u alaa quloobil-mu'tadeen
Thumma ba'athnaa min ba'dihim moosaa wa haaroona ilaa fir'awna wa mala'ihi bi-aayaatinaa fastakbaroo wa kaanoo qawman mujrimeen
Falammaa jaa'ahumul-haqqu min indinaa qaaloo inna haadhaa lasihrun mubeen
Qaala moosaa ataqooloona lilhaqqi lammaa jaa'akum asihrun haadhaa wa laa yuflihus-saahiroon
Qaaloo aji'tanaa litalfitanaa ammaa wajadnaa alayhi aabaa'anaa wa takoona lakumal-kibriyaa'u fil-ardi wa maa nahnu lakumaa bimu'mineen
Wa qaala fir'awnu u'toonee bikulli saahirin aleem
Falammaa jaa'as-saharatu qaala lahum moosaa alqoo maa antum mulqoon
Falammaa alqaw qaala moosaa maa ji'tum bihis-sihru innallaaha sayubtiluhu innallaaha laa yuslihu amalal-mufsideen
Wa yuhiqqu Allaahul-haqqa bikalimaatihi wa law karihal-mujrimoon
Famaa aamana limoosaa illaa dhurriyyatun min qawmihi alaa khawfin min fir'awna wa mala'ihim an yaftinahum wa inna fir'awna la-aalin fil-ardi wa innahu laminal-musrifeen
Wa qaala moosaa yaa qawmi in kuntum aamantum Billaahi fa-alayhi tawakkaloo in kuntum muslimeen
Faqaaloo alaa Allaahi tawakkalnaa rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa fitnatan lilqawmiz-zaalimeen
Wa najjinaa birahmatika minal-qawmil-kaafireen
Wa awhaynaa ilaa moosaa wa akheehi an tabawwa'aa liqawmikumaa bimisra buyootan waj'aloo buyootakum qiblatan wa aqeemus-salaata wa bashshiril-mu'mineen

Wa qaala moosaa rabbanaa innaka aatayta fir'awna wa mala'ahu zeenatan wa amwaalan fil-hayaatid-dunyaa rabbanaa liyudilloo an sabeelika rabbanaa itmis alaa amwaalihim washdud alaa quloobihim falaa yu'minoo hattaa yaraw al-adhaabal-aleem
Qaala qad ujeebat da'watukumaa fastaqeemaa wa laa tattabi'aani sabeelal-ladheena laa ya'lamoon

Wa jaawaznaa bibanee israa'eelal-bahra fa-atba'ahum fir'awnu wa junooduhu baghyan wa-adwan hattaa idhaa adrakahul-gharaqu qaala aamantu annahu laa ilaaha illal-ladhee aamanat bihi banoo israa'eela wa anaa minal-muslimeen
Aal'aana wa qad asayta qablu wa kunta minal-mufsideen
Fal-yawma nunajjeeka bibadanika litakoona liman khalfaka aayatan wa inna katheeran minan-naasi an aayaatinaa laghaafiloon

Wa laqad bawwa'naa banee israa'eela mubawwa'a sidqin wa razaqnaahum minat-tayyibaati famakh-talafoo hattaa jaa'ahumul-ilmu inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
Fa-in kunta fee shakkin mimmaa anzalnaa ilayka faas'alil-ladheena yaqra'oonal-kitaaba min qablika laqad jaa'akal-haqqu min rabbika falaa takoonanna minal-mumtareen
Wa laa takoonanna minal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaati Allaahi fatakoona minal-khaasireen
Innal-ladheena haqqat alayhim kalimatu rabbika laa yu'minoon
Wa law jaa'athum kullu aayatin hattaa yaraw al-adhaabal-aleem
Falawlaa kaanat qaryatun aamanat fanafa'ahaa eemaanuhaa illaa qawma yoonis lammaa aamanoo kashafnaa anhum adhaabal-khizyi fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa matta'naahum ilaa heen
Wa law shaa'a rabbuka la-aamana man fil-ardi kulluhum jamee'an afa'anta tukrihun-naasa hattaa yakoonoo mu'mineen
Wa maa kaana linafsin an tu'mina illaa bi-idhni Allaahi wa yaj'alur-rijsa alal-ladheena laa ya'qiloon
Qul unzuroo maadhaa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa tughnil-aayaatu wan-nudhuru an qawmin laa yu'minoon
Fahal yantaziroona illaa mithla ayyaamil-ladheena khalaw min qablihim qul fantaziroo innee ma'akum minal-muntazireen
Thumma nunajjee rusulanaa wal-ladheena aamanoo kadhaalika haqqan alaynaa nunjil-mu'mineen
Qul yaa ayyuhan-naasu in kuntum fee shakkin min deenee falaa a'budul-ladheena ta'budoona min doonillaahi wa laakin a'budu Allaahal-ladhee yatawaffaakum wa umirtu an akoona minal-mu'mineen
Wa an aqim wajhaka lid-deeni haneefan wa laa takoonanna minal-mushrikeen
Wa laa tad'u min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa'uka wa laa yadurruka fa-in fa-alta fa-innaka idhan minaz-zaalimeen
Wa in yamsaska Allaahu bidurrin falaa kaashifa lahu illaa huwa wa in yuridka bikhayrin falaa raadda lifadlihi yuseebu bihi man yashaa'u min ibaadihi wa huwal-ghafoorur-Raheem
Qul yaa ayyuhan-naasu qad jaa'akumul-haqqu min rabbikum famani ihtadaa fa-innamaa yahtadee linafsihi wa man dalla fa-innamaa yadillu alayhaa wa maa anaa alaykum biwakeel
Wattabi maa yoohaa ilayka wasbir hattaa yahkuma Allaahu wa huwa khayrul-haakimeen
